title: A declared clamp under a wheel path
rationale: A 5 mm clamp declared at (1240..1260, 120..160) lies under the rear wheel's track at C = 0 (safety-model 6.5; C-01). It is low enough that Z_safety clears it, so T-OBST does not fail. The robot profile has its body measured, and the clamp lies below the rear wheel, where the body hull is the wheel disc itself: the hull reaches it no earlier than the disc.
